description: Template block whose standalone dependencies are lazily loaded and rendered when a trigger fires.
Sub-blocks shown before the trigger, while loading (`after`, `minimum`) and on failure.
Loads the block's code on a different, earlier trigger than rendering.
TestBed option: `Playthrough` (default, real triggers) or `Manual` (drive states with `getDeferBlocks()` and `render(state)`).
SSR feature using `hydrate on ...` triggers to hydrate deferred content on demand.
